title: Giving instructions
scenario: You are in a teacher role. Use English naturally in this giving instructions situation.

lines.text: You must follow the instructions carefully during the test.
Understood, teacher. Should we write our names on the paper?
Yes, write your full name at the top of the page.
Could we use a dictionary for the reading section?
No, this is a closed-book test. Please put it away.
If we make a mistake, should we cross it out neatly?
Yes, draw one line through the wrong answer and rewrite.
Thank you for the clear instructions.
